StackPanel.TextBlock: June 1985. As war erupts in Europe, Soviet long-range naval forces surge into the Indian Ocean to threaten the tanker routes that sustain allied operations from the Gulf to Australia.A hastily assembled U.S.-led maritime force centered on Diego Garcia, Fremantle, and northwest Australia is ordered to hold the sea lines of communication open, protect coalition convoys, and blunt any Soviet attempt to sever NATO's southern logistics corridor.You command the surface task force designated SOUTHERN SENTINEL. Your force will fight across chokepoints, open-ocean convoy lanes, and contested amphibious approaches. Losses will carry forward. Choose your engagements carefully.
